AssignCertificateCount.description_en: Assigns the certificate quota to a subordinate certificate authority (CA) instance

CreateClientCertificate.description_en: Issues a single client certificate based on a system-generated certificate signing request (CSR)
CreateClientCertificate.description_zh: 基于系统自动生成的CSR签发单个客户端证书

CreateClientCertificateWithCsr.description_en: Issues a single client certificate based on a custom certificate signing request (CSR)
CreateClientCertificateWithCsr.description_zh: 基于自定义的CSR签发单个客户端证书

CreateCustomCertificate.description_en: Issues a custom digital certificate with specified subject, subject alternative names (SANs), key usage, and extended key usage attributes
CreateCustomCertificate.description_zh: 使用指定的证书主体名称、证书主题别名、密钥用法、扩展密钥用法颁发数字证书

CreateExternalCACertificate.description_en: Creates and issues an external subordinate CA certificate based on a CSR and API parameters
CreateExternalCACertificate.description_zh: 基于CSR和API参数创建并颁发外部子CA证书

CreateRevokeClientCertificate.description_en: Revokes a client certificate or a server certificate issued by a private certificate authority (CA)
CreateRevokeClientCertificate.description_zh: 吊销某个客户端证书或服务端证书

CreateRootCACertificate.description_en: Creates a root certificate authority (CA) certificate

CreateServerCertificate.description_en: Issues a single server certificate based on a system-generated certificate signing request (CSR)
CreateServerCertificate.description_zh: 基于系统自动生成的CSR签发单个服务端证书

CreateServerCertificateWithCsr.description_en: Issues a single server certificate based on a custom CSR
CreateServerCertificateWithCsr.description_zh: 基于自定义的CSR签发单个服务端证书

DeleteClientCertificate.description_en: Deletes a revoked client certificate or server certificate. Only revoked certificates can be deleted
DeleteClientCertificate.description_zh: 删除已吊销的客户端证书或服务端证书

DescribeCACertificate.description_en: Queries the details of a CA certificate

DescribeCACertificateCount.description_en: Queries the number of certificate authority (CA) certificates that you created
DescribeCACertificateCount.description_zh: 查询已创建的CA证书的数量

DescribeCACertificateList.description_en: Queries information about all root CA certificates and subordinate CA certificates
DescribeCACertificateList.description_zh: 查询所有根CA证书和子CA证书的信息

DescribeCertificatePrivateKey.description_en: Queries the encrypted private key of a client certificate or server certificate
DescribeCertificatePrivateKey.description_zh: 获取单个客户端证书或服务端证书的私钥（加密格式）

DescribeClientCertificate.description_en: Retrieves a client certificate or server certificate by its unique identifier
DescribeClientCertificate.description_zh: 通过证书的唯一识别码查询单个客户端证书或服务端证书的详细信息

DescribeClientCertificateForSerialNumber.description_en: Queries the details of client certificates or server certificates in batch by certificate serial number
DescribeClientCertificateForSerialNumber.description_zh: 通过证书的序列号批量查询客户端证书或服务端证书的详细信息

DescribeClientCertificateStatus.description_en: Queries the status information of client certificates and server certificates by their unique identifiers
DescribeClientCertificateStatus.description_zh: 通过证书的唯一识别码查询客户端证书和服务端证书的状态信息

DescribeClientCertificateStatusForSerial.description_en: Queries the status of client certificates and server certificates by certificate serial number
DescribeClientCertificateStatusForSerial.description_zh: 通过证书的序列号查询客户端证书和服务端证书的状态信息

DescribePcaAndExternalCACertificateList.description_en: Returns all CA certificates for the user, including certificates generated internally by PCA and imported external certificates
DescribePcaAndExternalCACertificateList.description_zh: 返回用户所有CaCertificate，包括PCA内部产生的与导入的外部证书

GetCAInstanceStatus.description_en: Queries the status of a private certificate authority (CA) instance, including the remaining certificate quota
GetCAInstanceStatus.description_zh: 查询您通过SSL证书服务控制台购买的私有根CA实例或私有子CA实例的状态信息

GetCaInstanceCrlAddress.description_en: Retrieves the certificate revocation list (CRL) URL of a certificate authority (CA)

ListAllEndEntityInstance.description_en: Queries the end-entity instances under a private certificate authority (CA)

ListCACertificateLog.description_en: Queries the operation logs of a certificate authority (CA) certificate, such as issuance and revocation events

ListClientCertificate.description_en: Lists all client certificates and server certificates issued by a private certificate authority (CA)
ListClientCertificate.description_zh: 查询所有客户端证书和服务端证书的详细信息

ListRevokeCertificate.description_en: Queries all revoked client certificates and server certificates
ListRevokeCertificate.description_zh: 查询所有已被吊销的客户端证书和服务端证书的详细信息

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries the tags that are attached to Certificate Management Service resources
ListTagResources.description_zh: 查询资源（SSL证书实例）和标签的对应关系

MoveResourceGroup.description_en: Moves a Certificate Management Service resource to a different resource group
MoveResourceGroup.description_zh: 修改资源所属的资源组

TagResources.description_en: Attaches tags to one or more Certificate Management Service resources
TagResources.description_zh: 为指定资源（SSL证书实例）绑定标签

UntagResources.description_en: Removes tags from one or more Certificate Management Service resources

UpdateCACertificateStatus.description_en: Changes the status of a root or subordinate certificate authority (CA) certificate, such as revoking or disabling an active CA
UpdateCACertificateStatus.description_zh: 将根CA证书或子CA证书的状态由正常签发修改为吊销

UpdatePcaCertificate.description_en: Updates the properties of a private CA certificate, such as the export status

UploadPcaCertToCas.description_en: Uploads a private CA certificate to Certificate Management Service for centralized management
